title: Glossa captures v1: the manifest of one capture upload (RFC 0004 §3.1–§3.3)
description: Written by `glossa capture` and uploaded with the build, one multipart part per distinct image. Each capture is one (route, viewport, locale): a page image and the regions where messages were rendered on it. Boxes are CSS pixels relative to the top-left of the full page; the image is those pixels times viewport.deviceScaleFactor. The server validates and re-encodes every image, so image.sha256 names the uploaded part, not the stored object.

route.description: The route pattern from the capture plan (/checkout/[step]), matching usages' route.

url.description: The concrete URL navigated to. Informational: Glossa never fetches it.

locale.description: The locale the page was rendered in (BCP 47).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the uploaded PNG bytes; names its multipart part.

renders.description: The session's render log: what each marker index rendered. Every region index refers to one entry.

locale.description: The locale the message resolved from.

findings.description: What the visual probe pass found on this capture (RFC 0005 §5), measured live in the page while it was open. Optional: a capture taken without probes carries none, and an empty list means the probes ran and found nothing. At most 500 per capture.

finding.description: One glossa.finding/v1 finding as the page can write it (finding.v1.schema.json). Two members of that shape are deliberately absent, because the page cannot know them and a guess would be worse than a gap: `fingerprint`, which hashes the catalog message ID a browser never has, and `locus.capture`, which the server mints. The ingest completes both.

layer.description: A capture's findings are the visual layer's.

severity.description: Always `warning`: a visual finding becomes eligible for `error` only when the same fingerprint appears in two consecutive captures (RFC 0005 §5.2), which only the server can see, and a page may not grade itself.

locus.description: As much of the finding's locus as the page knows. The server adds the capture, and resolves the key to a catalog message.

region.description: `r_<index into this capture's regions>`; the ingest pairs it with the capture it is on.
Where a rendered message is on the page. A component-rendered message is found by its host element's data-glossa-id (key); a t() string by its invisible marker (index into renders).

kind.description: element: the host element's box. text: a marked text range. attribute: the box of the element whose attribute holds the message.

attribute.description: For kind attribute: the attribute's name (placeholder, title, aria-label).

visible.description: false when the message rendered zero-size or off-screen, so the gap shows.
